editionLabel: English section · twenty-page bilingual publisher PDF
location: Course of the Game, opening sentence
firstPlayerRule: Whoever has the wildest outfit starts.

editionLabel: English section · four-page multilingual publisher PDF
firstPlayerRule: The person who most recently ate a tomato reveals the first card.
clarifications: That player shows the card to everyone at once. Everyone may race to name the matching hidden item; this is not an exclusive answering turn.

editionLabel: English section · twenty-page multilingual publisher PDF
location: Get Started; Now the search begins
firstPlayerRule: The person who most recently petted a cat is the first cat seeker.
clarifications: This is a cooperative role: the other players make animal sounds to guide the blindfolded cat seeker.

editionLabel: English section · sixteen-page multilingual publisher PDF
location: Course of the Game: Shake the thicket; Grab the animals
firstPlayerRule: The person who most recently petted an animal shakes the thicket first.
clarifications: After the thicket is set down facing everyone, all players grab animals at the same time. The selection assigns the opening shake, not a first grabbing turn.

editionLabel: English section · thirty-two-page multilingual publisher PDF
firstPlayerRule: Whoever lives nearest to 13 Calamity Lane in Bakersfield, California starts.
clarifications: Turns then proceed clockwise. This is the location specified by the English section of this manual.
evidenceNotes: The complete publisher rulebook was used, not the separate print-and-play adaptation or smartphone-stand template also linked by the product page.
